text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wha… what is this?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Commence! Let the dorm quiz battle begin! I wish you all the best of luck!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right, Miho crew! You better not lose to Ritto!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dormitory Students
text_block_list.text: Let's gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ritto Dormitory! We'll be celebrating tonight! So, let's enjoy this battle of the brains, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dormitory Students
text_block_list.text: Yeeeahhh!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, you came, City! Didn't you say you had work?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: We had a schedule change… Anyway, what's all this commotion?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few hours earlier…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: It is clear! Races are at times a battle of wits!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hence, we want to provide an opportunity to test your thinking under pressure. I present to you… a quiz competition!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Your teams are arranged by dorm! Work together for a chance to win the grand prize we've prepared! Get ready! Let's go go go!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: City, you're competing with us on the Ritto Dorm team. There'll be a buzzer quiz and a scatter quiz.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Do you know what a scatter quiz is? Envelopes containing questions are scattered about, which we find and bring back to the host to answer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And the dorm with the highest overall score wins. Simple, right? I'm confident you'll be a great contributor, City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Are you now? …Well, I don't really have a preference, so Trainer, which should I join?
choice_data_list: Test your speed in the buzzer quiz.
Test your resolve in the scatter quiz.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: A test of speed, huh. Sounds simple enough.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Question! What is defined as zero degrees, zero minutes, and zero seconds longitude?! A: the prime meridian, or B: the date line?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The answer is B for Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Wrong! The correct answer is A: the prime meridian!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What?! My Bakushin intuition was off?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That was close… I have to hit the button faster next time…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Next question! Finish the sentence! "Eating persimmons—"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I know! "Makes you want to eat pears and chestnuts too!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Urgh! Wrong again! But oh well—there's still more chances! Yes, I still have a chance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As class representative, I will be the first to hit the buzzer each time! Eheh!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Be first… every time…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Huh.
choice_data_list: (Something seems different about City all of a sudden.)

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Now, next question! The oldest U—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Turkmenistan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding ding ding!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: How?! You didn't even finish listening to the entire question!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wait… Are you psychic, City?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No, it just so happens the same question was asked on a quiz show this model I know was on.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If my opponent is fast, I have to be faster. It's time to catch up.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Go, go, Ritto Dormitory! What a riveting comeback!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Your strength and determination never changes. I love it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City's staggering comeback helps her dormitory win the competition!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: The scatter quiz… Well, a little moving around would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We head over to the beach where the game will take place. There, a helicopter flying overhead scatters a huge number of envelopes containing the questions!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Start!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: And they're off to a clean start, making a beeline for the envelopes!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Okay, that envelope is gonna be mine—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Outta my way! Speed demon comin' through!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh no—she beat me to it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What're ya doin', City? Get outta da way if you're not gonna run!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: D-damn it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The participants begin heading back to the quiz master, kicking up trails of dust in their wake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once there, they open up the envelopes and take a crack at the questions written inside.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What do you mean "blank"?!

text_block_list.name: Quiz Master
text_block_list.text: It looks like you brought an envelope with no question inside! You'll have to run for another one!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Are you—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Urgh… I know!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Currently, Miho Dormitory is in the lead! Will Ritto Dormitory make a comeback?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right, let's keep this lead, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Not if I have anything to say about it!

text_block_list.name: Quiz Master
text_block_list.text: Sorry! This one is also empty!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: One more try!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Resident
text_block_list.text: City's all sweaty and covered in sand…

text_block_list.name: Quiz Master
text_block_list.text: Well done! Five points to Ritto Dormitory!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: All right! Now for another!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Resident
text_block_list.text: Even with all the sweat and sand, she's still so beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: What a surprise! Listen to the cheers for Gold City coming from both sides!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, isn't that a slick move? Captivatin' the crowd with your determination.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: She's quick on her feet, but we better not underestimate her willpower either!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City's inspiring efforts invigorate the quiz participants, ultimately leading her dorm's team to victory.
